# KXH Storage & Logistics

> KXH Storage & Logistics is a London storage, moving and logistics company. We collect items from homes, student halls and businesses, store them in our secure managed London warehouse and deliver them back on request. We also provide home and office removals, packing, pallet and business storage, inventory management, third party logistics (3PL) and secure document shredding across London.

- Phone: 020 3916 5312 (main), 07470 025636 (mobile and WhatsApp)
- Email: help@kxhlogistics.co.uk
- Address: 9 New City Road, London E13 9LL
- Opening hours: open 24 hours, 7 days a week
- Areas served: London, including Camden, Westminster, Hackney, Islington, Kensington & Chelsea, Tower Hamlets, Southwark and Lambeth
- Instant online quotes: https://kxhlogistics.co.uk/get-a-quote
